newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha dips $1 with crude, parafinnic tight.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha dips $1 with crude, parafinnic tight.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices slipped $1 a tonne on Wednesday, tracking weaker Brent futures and modest demand.

"The whole market is being driven by crude at the moment. Physical is still fairly tight for parafinnic grades but most people are just wating to see if those prices follow swaps lower," said a large petrochemical end user.

Brokers said Nov swaps were about $221.50 compared to physical prices around $228. Dec swaps were nearer $215.50. Dealers said the loading programmes for Algerian and other north African grades would be pivotal in the next price move. "Any tightness from Algeria could quickly push prices back up," said a trader.
